title: Creating a Lens of Chinese Culture: A Multimodal Dataset for Chinese Pun Rebus Art Understanding
reasoning: The benchmark includes 'Moral Integrity, Eremitism' (Category F) and 'Peace and Protection from Evil, Societal Harmony' (Category G) as core evaluative labels for the symbolic matching task. The authors specifically analyze and discuss the performance and biases of models like GPT-4o and Gemini Pro in interpreting these moral and societal themes.
